verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server, both local and remotely hosted at mcp.paypal.com, that lets merchants operate PayPal "using natural language with their favorite MCP clients." Its documented tool inventory spans invoices, orders, refunds, disputes, subscriptions, catalog, shipment tracking and reporting, and each tool ships with a sample natural-language prompt. The agent toolkit extends this across major agent frameworks and LLMs from Anthropic and OpenAI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably in practice.
